name: Start
author: WinDock
description: A Start button: opens the Start menu (the Windows key, sent with SendInput; if Windows refuses the input, the All apps folder opens instead). The Windows logo or your own icon.

settings.label: Icon
settings.description: What the button shows: the blue Windows logo, the logo in the theme's text colour, or your own image (below). Default: the blue logo.

choices.label: An image or a file's icon (below)

settings.label: Image
settings.description: A file of the widget (assets/start.png, after exporting it) or the full path of any file, whose shell icon is drawn (an .exe, .ico, .lnk ...).

settings.label: Icon size (percent of the slot)
settings.description: How much of the slot the icon fills. Default: 62%.
